name: Sharma East India Hospitals & Medical Research Ltd
about: Sharma East India Hospitals & Medical Research Ltd, a multi-specialty hospital, provides medical and healthcare services. It offers various services, such as obstetrics and gynaecology for women's health, general and laparoscopic surgery, general medicine, orthopedic surgery with joint replacement, cardiology and CTVS for heart and vascular care, plastic and reconstructive surgery, pathology, ENT, ophthalmology, neurology, pediatrics, and ICU and emergency. In addition, it also provides diagnostics and imaging, and physiotherapy and rehabilitation services. The company runs hospital under the brand name Jaipur Hospital. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Jaipur, India.
